title: Newtonian cavity baseline at n = 1000 against Marchi et al.
caption: Newtonian lid-driven cavity in the thesis configuration (viscous form laplacian, EPS factor 1e-6, adami walls) at Re = 1000, n = 1000 (1,046,529 particles with the walls, h = 5 dx, Ma = 0.01, dt = 7.5e-06 L / U, K = 1), from rest, against the reference of Marchi et al. (2021). (a) u on x = L / 2 and (b) v on y = L / 2 at the 28 + 28 reference points: reference (black points joined by a thin line) and the run (circles; MLS samples in the wall frame, mean of 99 samples over the last 20 time units, to t = 99.8 L / U; the run passed its steady test at t = 69.5). (c), (d) Run minus reference at the same points, in units of 1e-3 U. L2 error of u 1.42e-03 U (largest 5.31e-03), of v 9.49e-04 U (largest 2.28e-03). Extreme values at the reference points: min u on x = L / 2 (y = 0.172 L) -0.38955 against -0.388569 (-9.8e-04 U, 0.25 % in magnitude); max v on y = L / 2 (x = 0.156 L) 0.37820 against 0.376917 (+1.3e-03 U, 0.34 % in magnitude); min v on y = L / 2 (x = 0.906 L) -0.52781 against -0.526418 (-1.4e-03 U, 0.26 % in magnitude). The remaining error sits next to the lid and to the right wall: u at the four points nearest the lid (y = 0.953 to 0.977 L) +1.5e-03, +2.5e-03, +3.9e-03, +5.3e-03 U, every other u point within 1.1e-03 U; v at the four points nearest the right wall (x = 0.945 to 0.969 L) +5.0e-04, +1.1e-03, +1.8e-03, +2.3e-03 U. Without the points within 0.05 L of a wall the rms error is 4.45e-04 U (u, 24 points) and 7.92e-04 U (v, 25 points). Fluid density range 0.12 % of rho0 (mean over the window). Run `n1000_laplacian_eps1em6`, Stage 3 (design note 12.8), commit 7e76dcb (`micropolar-base-13-g7e76dcb`; the data file is in the tree since `thesis-ch5-rc1`); existing data, not rerun on thesis-ch5-rc2. The walls of this configuration are slightly porous (item 13).
